data.outcome_summary: This OECD Education at a Glance 2025 Belgium country note summarises key characteristics of the education system using published indicators, with emphasis on tertiary education. It reports descriptive comparisons and trends such as intergenerational educational inequality in tertiary attainment, unemployment rates by educational attainment, and literacy proficiency patterns from the Survey of Adult Skills (PIAAC), including differences by parental education and attainment groups. It also covers education participation and progression indicators (e.g., entry pathways into tertiary education, completion rates for bachelor’s programmes, gender differences, and international student mobility), and system inputs such as government expenditure per student and teacher workforce indicators. The note does not present an original student-level modeling approach, does not report ML model performance metrics, and does not provide microdata sampling/replicate-weight or PV/missing-data procedures within the country-note text; those are instead directed to the linked Education at a Glance 2025 indicator tables and technical notes.
